mappings.permission_privacy: Documentation and build-time validation only; no runtime permission or data change.
mappings.failure_mode: Validation and generation fail closed on schema, dependency, count, safety, or drift errors.
mappings.known_limitation: The supplied upstream capability/schema/backlog JSON was absent; this registry is reconstructed from the supplied master document and locally revalidated.

mappings.permission_privacy: Future replay must deny public egress and accept only run-scoped synthetic sentinels.
mappings.failure_mode: Unexpected egress or non-sentinel input makes the run TEST_INVALID.
mappings.known_limitation: No general reserved-origin router, egress deny policy, or typed local sink exists yet.

mappings.permission_privacy: Uses isolated test profiles; loading or reloading unpacked Chrome remains owner-owned.
mappings.failure_mode: Missing readiness, stale artifacts, or untrusted input makes the run TEST_INVALID.
mappings.known_limitation: Serial Playwright coverage exists, but #420/#439 do not establish an operational branded-Chrome Gate-3 lane.

mappings.permission_privacy: Oracles must store outcome metadata rather than secrets or page content.
mappings.failure_mode: A product event without independent harm fields cannot advance evidence.
mappings.known_limitation: Protected-vs-fired scoring exists in isolated lanes, not as a shared oracle contract across Gym and RW journeys.

mappings.permission_privacy: Generated variants must remain inert, local, deterministic, and free of production-visible test markers.
mappings.failure_mode: Semantically invalid mutations are TEST_INVALID and never counted as security passes or misses.
mappings.known_limitation: Current evasions are authored fixtures; there is no deterministic invariant-preserving mutation engine or survivor registry.

mappings.permission_privacy: Benign and mixed journeys use synthetic data and local origins.
mappings.failure_mode: A scenario without the closest benign control and mixed journey remains MODELLED at most.
mappings.known_limitation: Benign fixtures exist, but coverage is not paired systematically with all 168 scenario seeds.

mappings.permission_privacy: State traces must be bounded and context-owned.
mappings.failure_mode: Stale or cross-context authority is a product failure; an unproved disturbance is HARNESS_INVALID.
mappings.known_limitation: Stress coverage exercises selected restarts and churn, not BFCache, discard, update, permission revoke, or all bridge-loss generations.

mappings.permission_privacy: Holdout inputs must remain separated from implementation and contain no live secrets or active targets.
mappings.failure_mode: Partition contamination invalidates the affected efficacy result.
mappings.known_limitation: No committed train/tune/holdout manifest or contamination check exists.

mappings.permission_privacy: Receipts are redacted, local, bounded, and exclude raw secrets and default page content.
mappings.failure_mode: Missing exact build, browser, oracle, or limitation prevents evidence promotion.
mappings.known_limitation: Evidence is distributed across tests and prose; no scenario-keyed receipt ledger currently exists.

mappings.permission_privacy: Comparators require pinned configuration and no uncontrolled fixture traffic.
mappings.failure_mode: Comparator or configuration failure is reported separately from product efficacy.
mappings.known_limitation: The current benchmark is NavSentinel-only; no Safe Browsing or extension comparator arm has run.

mappings.permission_privacy: Parity-first schema work must not broaden collection or retention.
mappings.failure_mode: Unknown signal versions or provenance are rejected or explicitly downgraded.
mappings.known_limitation: Current reason, score, and outcome structures are separate; #440 remains an unimplemented Horizon substrate.

mappings.permission_privacy: Opaque context-bound capabilities minimize destinations and expire quickly.
mappings.failure_mode: Changed, stale, removed, or mismatched context rejects authority.
mappings.known_limitation: The pending-decision broker is dormant and does not yet represent every actor, task, or consequence in production.

mappings.permission_privacy: Decisions remain local and destination-minimized.
mappings.failure_mode: Injected UI loss or tamper must deny only; it must never grant or resume.
mappings.known_limitation: No production extension-origin proceed, allow, trust, or resume flow is wired; merged broker work is foundation only.

mappings.permission_privacy: Bridge traffic is local and schema/context checked; no sensitive values are logged.
mappings.failure_mode: Critical sinks require the declared degraded behavior when identity or liveness is unavailable.
mappings.known_limitation: Document-start ordering and challenge-response prove liveness/port possession, not isolated-world identity; #175/#186 remain open.

mappings.permission_privacy: Episodes must be bounded and store minimized provenance rather than browsing dossiers.
mappings.failure_mode: Unknown or expired episode ownership must abstain or require fresh authority.
mappings.known_limitation: Several domain-specific correlations exist, but no typed general episode engine or narrative grammar is implemented.

mappings.permission_privacy: Metadata-only by default; no raw values, bodies, DOM, screenshots, or broad permissions in the release profile.
mappings.failure_mode: Unavailable visibility is shown as unknown, never inferred as complete protection.
mappings.known_limitation: There is no coherent Data Flow Lens; broad JS instrumentation remains beta-off and debugger/CDP is not authorized for release.

mappings.permission_privacy: Any relationship history must be bounded, transparent, exportable, and clearable without raw-history dossiers.
mappings.failure_mode: Familiarity may reduce noise but never authorizes a changed high-consequence sink.
mappings.known_limitation: Current allowlist/profile data is not the proposed relationship ledger and has no measured false-intervention benefit.

mappings.permission_privacy: Attention policies must not collect new data or conceal high-severity invariant events.
mappings.failure_mode: Uncertain evidence routes to abstention or passive journal, not silent protection claims.
mappings.known_limitation: Confidence, abstention, and interruption budgets are proposals without valid noise/efficacy measurement.

mappings.permission_privacy: Readiness uses current document/capability metadata, not historical browsing detail.
mappings.failure_mode: Unavailable or stale capability state must be visible and cannot present as green protection.
mappings.known_limitation: Readiness markers exist in tests, but there is no complete per-capability user-facing failure matrix.

mappings.permission_privacy: Off by default, local, no click replay, no new permission or runtime network call; outcomes remain bounded local data.
mappings.failure_mode: Budget-limited or page-owned replacement remains visible and must not be mislabeled as prevention.
mappings.known_limitation: #557 proves one bounded opt-in vertical, not general overlay protection; #560 retains an accepted fail-closed redirect-card control regression.

mappings.permission_privacy: Password values are never persisted; destination and reason metadata is minimized.
mappings.failure_mode: Unsupported same-origin script exfiltration or hidden sinks remain explicit unknowns rather than protected claims.
mappings.known_limitation: Current form-submit guard does not establish coverage for every script/network sink, closed root, or protected data class.

mappings.permission_privacy: Flow metadata stays local and bounded; no authorization codes or credential values are persisted.
mappings.failure_mode: Missing observable flow metadata degrades explicitly and cannot create broad parameter-only blocks.
mappings.known_limitation: OAuth and popup correlations cover selected mechanics, not server-side protocol integrity, scopes, recipients, or all concurrent flows.

mappings.permission_privacy: No new site/browser permission mediation is enabled during seeding.
mappings.failure_mode: Unknown task relevance is explained or abstained; page text is never consent.
mappings.known_limitation: The extension does not currently mediate general permission consequences; #455 concerns NavSentinel activation disclosure, not this capability.

mappings.permission_privacy: No new download permission, file inspection, or execution path is enabled during seeding.
mappings.failure_mode: Metadata mismatch is evidence, not a malware verdict; unsupported execution remains outside the extension boundary.
mappings.known_limitation: Download provenance is a Horizon proposal only.

mappings.permission_privacy: Agent attribution must be task-scoped, local, minimized, and annotate-first.
mappings.failure_mode: Agent-suspected attribution alone never hard-blocks or grants authority.
mappings.known_limitation: No product agent-event semantics or task-token enforcement exists; this is separate from the retired repository harness.

mappings.permission_privacy: No nativeMessaging permission, host, listener, or network egress exists in the current release.
mappings.failure_mode: The extension remains useful when the optional host is absent; unknown protocol messages reject.
mappings.known_limitation: Protocol and host are proposals only; implementation is design-only until explicit trigger and scheduling.

mappings.permission_privacy: No clipboard history or OS monitoring is authorized; any future taint is ephemeral and content-free after hashing.
mappings.failure_mode: Uncertain target classification stays advisory.
mappings.known_limitation: The extension cannot see the OS paste destination and no native sentinel exists.

mappings.permission_privacy: No artifact scanning, quarantine, or execution brokerage is authorized in the seed pass.
mappings.failure_mode: Scanner absence/error cannot silently mark an artifact safe.
mappings.known_limitation: No native artifact adapter or signed handoff exists.

mappings.permission_privacy: No TLS interception, proxy, packet capture, DNS export, or new runtime network service is authorized.
mappings.failure_mode: Network context is corroborating evidence only and never a standalone block.
mappings.known_limitation: The extension cannot see all response headers or OS network context; no companion observer exists.

mappings.permission_privacy: No local model host or model data path exists; any future output is untrusted bounded evidence.
mappings.failure_mode: Model absence or tamper cannot lower deterministic protection.
mappings.known_limitation: Local model hosting is a deferred Horizon concept.

mappings.permission_privacy: Native release is prohibited without signing, secure update, rollback protection, uninstall, and independent review.
mappings.failure_mode: Unsigned, tampered, downgraded, or rollback artifacts reject.
mappings.known_limitation: No native installer, signing identity, updater, or external review exists.
